source.title: Bangor Urban District (from 1928 Borough of Bangor), register of elections of councillors and aldermen, 1904-1958: "Register of Elections of Councillors" held on 15 January 1913 (PRONI LA/20/1/DA/1; Keep notes "LA/20/1/DA/1" #25, "LA/20/1/DA/1" #26 (photo numbers count from 0))
source.publisher: Public Record Office of Northern Ireland (Bangor Borough Council records)
source.check: candidates, votes, the result and the ward returns read from the photographed register, which the returning officer signed (owner's PRONI photographs, transcribed 10-11 Nov 2026); names as the register writes them; the register gives no party labels; candidates' addresses are not copied

note: Ordinary election of Bangor Urban District Council, 15 January 1913: one councillor in each ward. Bell Philip Sidney withdrew.
